title: Travelsoft Orchestra cyberattack, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Travelsoft, Orchestra, Voyages E.Leclerc, Carrefour Voyages, Selectour, Havas Voyages, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: A booking platform behind 'dozens' of French travel sites and agency tools, per the company's president. No count of travelers or agencies has been given.
who_is_affected: Customers and staff of travel brands that use Orchestra, including Voyages E.Leclerc, Carrefour Voyages, Selectour and Havas Voyages, and the travel agents who book through it.

known.text: The company's president says Orchestra was hit by a cyberattack with illicit access.
The company shut all its systems down as a precaution.
Voyages E.Leclerc, Carrefour Voyages, Selectour and Havas Voyages sites went offline.

not_known.text: Whether logins were taken, as TourMaG reports.
How the attackers got in, and who they are.
Which customer platform is still down, and whether it comes back Monday as the company says.
